notes.title: Coming Soon: More Updates!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

[b]TLDR[/b]: Sorry I was gone. Rough time with work and family health. Will be continuing work again later this year once current work project dies down and things improve.


[b]Full[/b]: First, apologies for the lack of updates. Between my previous job making it impossible to develop the game (or even talk about it) due to their contract, I was forced to take some time away from this Steam account. That coupled with multiple family members dealing with serious illness and unfortunately a death meant the game had taken a back seat for some time as I dealt with the fallout of those issues.

The good news is that later this year (after I finish my current project at work) I will start back up on development (in my spare time)! I have never stopped thinking about making this game, even in the break and will release it hopefully later next year. I have a better work life balance, better support and a new job coupled with family doing better overall health wise means this will actually be feasible to do again.

I want to thank everyone for the kind words in messages and the discussion board about wanting to see this game come out. Seeing those messages has kept me wanting to make the game as great as it can be. Hoping to release some new screenshots in the fall of some new areas and new enemies! :)

In the meantime know that this game is still on track for a [b](hopefully) later next year release[/b] and thanks for those who have reached out in one way or another. I will also be having more consistent communication over the winter months as well [b]once development starts again in the fall.[/b] 

Cheers!
Andrew

notes.title: Update #1: Updated Release Date
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Apologies for the lack of updates on the progress of the game so far. I have been very busy at my new job which, unfortunately, has taken up a lot more of my spare time with overtime than originally expected due to the project I am on.

Therefore, I regret to inform you all that the release window will be pushed to next year (likely in the later half of the year).

I am still planning on releasing the game as early access at that time, but would like to extend the date out to ensure that what is released in early access is of better quality and allows more time for community feedback and bug fixes.

With that said, looking forward to showing some new exciting content (models and areas) this fall!
